title: Tidemark
description: Classic turn-based strategy in the spirit of Advance Wars: build, capture and push the front with 33 land, sea and air units, 29 commanders each with a battle-turning power, and a 27-mission campaign. Every attack shows its odds first — damage forecast, counterattacks and unit matchups — while tech trees, ratings and score records reward careful play. Open-source (MIT) game by CocoSgt, integrated under the MIT license. Supports 10 languages, mouse, touch, keyboard and gamepad.
controls: Click or tap to select units, move and attack — damage odds are previewed before you commit. Keyboard shortcuts available in-game; touch and gamepad supported. Build units in your factories/ports/airports, capture cities and buildings for income, and destroy or capture the enemy HQ to win.
author: CocoSgt
